name: Cancellation negative credit at asset NET (not $0)
what_it_tests: A cancellation line (Qty=-1) must produce a NEGATIVE TotalPrice credit equal to the asset NET unit price (not list, not $0); the native waterfall seeds no NetUnitPrice for cancel lines so a custom seed supplies it
proc_mechanism: CancelNetUnitPrice__c seed (from AssetActionSource/SourceAsset NetUnitPrice) + V18 seed step; CancelLineCreditPosthook writes NetUnitPrice/TotalPrice/Subtotal via field-API names; Quantity*Price; Null-Safe Line Adjustment
expected_behavior: NetUnitPrice=asset net (e.g. 3000); TotalPrice = NetUnitPrice x -1 = -3000; quote/order header rolls up the negative credit
test_setup: Cancel quote/order, line Qty=-1, asset list 3000 no discount, CancelNetUnitPrice__c populated, expect -3000

run3_result.actual: Force-reprice ERRORS at StampBaseFilter#1 (SF-Pricing-00006 / SF-BRE-00004). Fresh cancel QLI (CancelNetUnitPrice__c=15000, NetUnitPrice=null) stays NetUnitPrice=null, TotalPrice=0. CalculationStatus=PriceCalculationFailed. Reproduced on 3 independent records: prior quotes 0Q0WC000003FZ290AG (QLI 0QLWC000003kiab4AA) and 0Q0WC000003FZ3l0AG (QLI 0QLWC000003kicD4AQ), and fresh new quote 0Q0WC000003FoMA0A0 (QLI 0QLWC000003kySU4AY, CancelNetUnitPrice__c=15000). Cancel order 801WC00000m1DvgYAE (OI 802WC00000PYOG3YAP) also fails with same error. CONTROL PASS: prior quote 0Q0WC000003EQtl0AG (QLI 0QLWC000003jbhd4AA) with NetUnitPrice already=15000 reprices successfully to TotalPrice=-15000, confirming CancelLineCreditPosthook is functional when StampBaseFilter is cleared.
run3_result.evidence: https://fortra--uat.sandbox.lightning.force.com/lightning/r/Quote/0Q0WC000003FoMA0A0/view (fresh cancel QLI 0QLWC000003kySU4AY, CancelNetUnitPrice__c=15000, NetUnitPrice=null post-reprice); https://fortra--uat.sandbox.lightning.force.com/lightning/r/Quote/0Q0WC000003EQtl0AG/view (control pass: NetUnitPrice=15000, TotalPrice=-15000); error: SF-Pricing-00006 StampBaseFilter#1 / SF-BRE-00004 on all fresh cancel lines
run3_result.defectStep: StampBaseFilter (parent step StampContributorBasePreDiscount): criterion #5 is 'NetUnitPrice GreaterThan 0' with no IsNotNull guard. Condition logic '(1 OR 2) AND 3 AND 4 AND 5' fails at evaluation because the rules engine cannot evaluate GreaterThan on a null NetUnitPrice (SF-BRE-00004). The reprice aborts before CancelLineCreditPosthook can seed the credit from CancelNetUnitPrice__c.
run3_result.proposedFix: Add an IsNotNull guard on criterion #5 of StampBaseFilter: change condition logic from '(1 OR 2) AND 3 AND 4 AND 5' to '(1 OR 2) AND 3 AND 4 AND (5 OR NetUnitPrice_IsNull_Guard)' where the guard is 'NetUnitPrice IsNull'.
